text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kicking up the turf, racing silks 
fluttering in the wind, accompanied by a 
fierce roar—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume swept around the final 
corner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOO...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looked straight ahead with 
singular focus, recklessly chasing that 
one-and-only glory.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother... I swear, I will save the 
House of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Young Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The teacher believes in me. That's why I 
want to get stronger. Strong enough to 
dominate any opponent, no matter how 
powerful!

text_block_list.name: Young Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best, sincerely and diligently. 
So that someday, I can become a fine 
Umamusume that Mom and Dad can be proud 
of.

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Sadness, and loneliness too. If we all 
hold hands together, I know we can turn it 
into happiness!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: I will! I will! I'm the one who...!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'll... Gaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the pinnacle of the Golden 
Generation! Derby Umamusume, ――――!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—An explosive cheer erupted. Applause 
thundered, and shouts of praise filled the 
air—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we did it! Congratulations, 
congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, tough luck...! But it was truly a 
fantastic race! Truly!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She was the "strongest in history"!! Let's 
all celebrate! Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congraaaats!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A true sense of unity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Patting each other on the back, sharing 
their joy, a place brimming with smiles 
and excitement—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was staring intently, utterly 
absorbed.

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Why are you watching races at a time like 
this? I don't want to. I'm sad right now."

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It's all right, come on. Lift your head, 
Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Where Mom pointed, there were Umamusume 
racing across the turf like flashes of 
light.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone has a look of desperation, 
putting everything they have into reaching 
the goal line—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... Everyone wants to win. 
...But why?"

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Why that is, is something only she 
herself would know."

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""Even so, I'm sure everyone holds a 
sparkling jewel within their heart.""

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"And that is something so precious, so 
profoundly important, that it is worth 
staking one's life on."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I don't clearly remember what I said in 
reply to Mom's words. But...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The moment the Umamusume crossed the 
finish line, a huge roar erupted, and 
applause echoed all around.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(That place was so warm, so fun, and full 
of... light—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It's the same—as the ring I saw that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A circle so warm, joyful, and filled with 
light...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers that enveloped them did not 
subside for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A truly happy ending.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so lively that it felt like it 
couldn't possibly get any more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I was defeated. And yet... even so, 
what remains here is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —What a magnificent view...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I returned to the waiting room 
with her. We lamented the result and 
praised each other for a fight well 
fought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And right then and there—
It was a "wonderful" “SOUL”.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was an unexpected visitor.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Still—the "end" isn't here yet.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Hubble"—did "her best." ...Victoire Pisa. 
"Good girl."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However, not yet. You are "Infinity"— and 
you will "Connect"... even further, even 
deeper.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Bigger, even bigger. 'Maysa'—bring 'Hope.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We can ‘weave’ it. —From ‘HPED’, to 
‘HPED’."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe... With an air of quiet 
mystery about her, the horse girl walked 
away.
choice_data_list: ...What on earth was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “Further, and further... ‘Connect’...”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean... there are still things 
left for me to weave...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san is... a mysterious person. 
She doesn't speak much, but she would 
never tell careless lies.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, judging from how she acted just 
now, she certainly didn't seem to be 
joking—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps she was able to sense something 
that we cannot understand."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if that is the case, then 
what on earth could it be?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Should she enter the Kikuka Sho as 
expected, or is there something else she 
ought to be doing?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That answer did not come for quite some 
time—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Pisa?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! Um... it has been a while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...... ...How have you... been?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, same as always, but... I'm doing 
well. Right now... um, we were just 
talking about Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
You know, about the Nippon Derby. Our 
track and field club has been super hyped 
up about it.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend B
text_block_list.text:
At my school too! Isn't it crazy? People 
were saying it was like the greatest 
lineup in history!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It reached all of you as well, didn't 
it? Thank you, um... it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... Hearing that Pisa's still 
giving it his all in races and getting 
properly recognized made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it's still hard for me to 
watch the races, but...

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll be rooting for you. Do your 
best...!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(“It's still too painful to watch 
races”...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how much time passes, that fire 
from back then still burns in her heart.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (It keeps smoldering—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the next day. Victoire Pisa came to me 
with something she wanted to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume racing creates inspiration and 
hope, and it even holds the power to 
connect people together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through the races, a bond among our 
generation was forged, and we were able to 
create a great circle of connection at the 
racecourse as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yet there are still... those who are left 
all alone. Not just those outside the 
race, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Those who have stepped away from 
racing have also been unable to weave it 
together."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
For instance... creating a circle of 
connections large enough to reach the 
hearts of even those people.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To create a massive, overwhelming fervor 
that reaches far beyond the racecourse 
itself—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Just how much of a pipe dream is this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not impossible. ...However, it will 
likely be extremely difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she can claim a spectacular victory on 
a grand stage and generate major buzz, 
then perhaps it might be possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words—for example.
choice_data_list:
Like claiming a magnificent victory at the 
"Arima Kinen"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is the year-end Grand 
Prix. Since the competing Umamusume are 
chosen by fan vote, it's a grand stage 
featuring a star-studded lineup of the 
era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why so many media outlets cover it, 
and the day of the race radiates a 
festival-like fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all that excitement, the rumors and 
fervor often reached people completely 
outside the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“...... At that place, not merely a 
'victory', but a 'magnificent victory', is 
it?”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I see, as expected... that is quite a high 
wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, even so... please. Please let me aim 
for victory in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So, please let me fulfill an even larger 
circle— my new destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden path toward the grand stage 
appeared. Even so... if it's her, both 
running and winning would certainly not be 
impossible dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, if it is something necessary 
for her dream—then I must do it.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If we are to run in the Arima Kinen and 
weave an even larger circle... there is 
much to be done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides honing her skills, we'll need to 
secure race entry via fan voting and build 
public anticipation, just like with the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Entering the Kikuka Sho is an option for 
that, but— if you want to raise your 
profile, a race that isn't restricted by 
generation would be better."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The best from across the country... no, 
from across the globe gather, creating 
massive hype around the race itself— that 
would have to be—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It would have to be... the 'Japan Cup', 
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is an international race 
held at Tokyo Racecourse. It is a grand 
stage where powerhouses from both home and 
abroad gather to decide the world's 
strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's plenty of buzz, and competing 
against the best will surely spur her 
growth even further."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next goal wasn't the Kikuka 
Sho, but the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The contents of that press conference 
caused quite a shock in the racing world— 
and, as expected, garnered a considerable 
amount of attention.
